title: Forest Nordic Rock Boulder Stone Medium 01
description:
The ‘Forest Nordic’ themed assets capture the rugged, quiet feel of dense northern woodland. Featuring high-fidelity scans of weathered tree trunks and branches, mossy boulders, and scattered bark, this collection reflects a landscape shaped by cold climate and dense growth.
Ideal for creating dense, natural wooded environments with a strong sense of scale and realism.
